skills.name: writing-agent-skills
skills.description: Guides writing, reviewing and testing agent skills (SKILL.md folders) for this hub and any Claude Code, Codex or custom-runtime consumer. Covers scoping, frontmatter limits, descriptions, progressive disclosure, scripts, evals, security and packaging. Use when creating a new skill, editing or reviewing an existing one, deciding whether something should be a skill, or debugging a skill that triggers wrongly. Not for writing project docs or system prompts.

skills.name: optimizing-databricks-cost
skills.description: Guides finding and reducing Databricks spend. Attributes DBU cost by product, job, warehouse and user, identifies the dominant driver, maps it to a concrete lever (serverless compute, warehouse sizing and auto-stop, streaming triggers, table layout and predictive optimization, budgets and alerts), and verifies the saving afterwards. Use when asked to cut, explain a rise in, or optimize Databricks cost or performance per dollar. Not for plain cost lookups such as "how much did X cost" (use system-tables-semantic) and not for applying the changes without confirmation.

skills.name: system-tables-access
skills.description: Use when the question is about which tables a user can access, which users can see a specific table, tag-based permissions, access control rules, or GPT/AI platform onboarding.

skills.name: system-tables-billing
skills.description: Use when the question is about individual query text, who ran a specific query, raw query history lookup, warehouse event details, or when you need the raw system.billing or system.query.history table columns for a non-aggregation query. For aggregated cost totals, rates, and trends use system-tables-semantic instead.

skills.name: system-tables-filters
skills.description: Use when querying Databricks system tables or information_schema: mandatory catalog, schema and 180-day time-window scope filters, and which objects must never be surfaced.

skills.name: system-tables-jobs
skills.description: Use when the question is about job definitions, task structures, task dependencies, job schedules, trigger types, individual job run detail rows (run IDs, termination codes, task-level breakdown), or pipeline workflows. For aggregated run stats (success rates, p95 duration, failure counts over time) use system-tables-semantic instead.

skills.name: system-tables-lineage
skills.description: Use when the question is about data lineage, upstream or downstream table dependencies, which jobs or notebooks write to a table, or what tables a pipeline reads from.

skills.name: system-tables-metadata
skills.description: Use when the question is about catalog names, schema names, table names, column definitions, table existence, table owners, data formats, or browsing the data catalog.

skills.name: system-tables-semantic
skills.description: Use when the question asks for aggregated metrics, rates, trends, or totals: DBU cost by user/workspace/product, job success or failure rates, job duration statistics (avg/p95), query performance trends, cache hit rates, or any "how much / how many / what percentage / what is the trend" question about Databricks operations. Prefer this skill over system-tables-billing or system-tables-jobs for aggregation questions.
